title: Ansel and the Ghost
author: Oscar Blackwood
blurb: Mirabel Nystrom, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
